title.from: Configure Discovery as Kanbus router intake

description.from: Migrate the Kanbus project status definitions to the state-native router contract. Mark Discovery as the canonical todo status; mark In Progress, Review, Blocked, and Done with semantic categories in_progress, in_review, blocked, and done respectively. Add the Discovery to In Progress workflow transition used when a worker claims an issue. Leave Ready and Backlog unmarked, and do not migrate existing router-labelled issues currently in Ready. Acceptance: project configuration validates, router planning selects an opted-in Discovery issue, and an otherwise eligible opted-in Ready issue remains ineligible.
description.to: Withdrawn. This issue was created in error and is not wanted; do not implement it. Nothing depends on it.
